description: Addresses frozen (blacklisted) by Tether and other stablecoin issuers on TRON: total count, freezes in the last 30 and 365 days, stablecoins locked on frozen addresses, and the most recent and largest frozen addresses. Use it for questions about Tether blacklisting trends or recent freezes; to check whether one particular address is frozen use check_address instead. Each listed freeze has address, stablecoin, frozen_at date and the balance locked; the response includes updated_at.

limit.description: How many of the most recent and of the largest freezes to return (each list gets this many). Totals are always included.

name: get_usdt_freezes
title: USDT freezes on TRON
